key.name: style
key.description: How a closing window disappears: 'mist' (drifts away as fine dust), 'pixels' (blocks blink out), 'fade' (shrinks, blurs and fades) or 'random' (mist or pixels).

key.name: duration
key.description: Length of the animation for normal windows, in milliseconds. Dialogs take a little under half of it.

key.name: keep-own-timing
key.description: Play at the duration set here even when the desktop's animations are sped up or slowed down.
